title: The Gun Factory Is Open
summary: Day one: one rifle blueprint, three worlds, and a muzzle shaped like a trumpet.

title: Seven Weapons Walk Into a Factory
summary: Pistols, shotguns, snipers, machine guns, SMGs and crossbows. Plus 30 new parts, and an official statement regarding bees.

title: Duct Tape, Double Barrels & Bows
summary: Every weapon gets its own shape, double barrels snap open, a whole scavenger world arrives, and so do the first bows.

title: Runes, Crystals & a Lever
summary: World #5 is fantasy, and a pile of reference pictures teaches the factory lever actions, machine pistols, hunting stocks and more.

title: Wood, Steel & History
summary: Three new worlds from the 20th century: World War I, World War II and the Vietnam era.

title: Every Army Needs a Look
summary: Faction families: one lucky number, one whole matching arsenal, with a name, a badge and a favorite set of parts.

title: Diesel & Neon
summary: Two new worlds: chrome-and-rivets dieselpunk and cable-and-sticker cyberpunk, with searchlights, exhaust stacks and LED ammo counters.

title: Ready to Paint
summary: Every gun now unfolds flat with no overlaps, plus three free texture maps, so artists can paint it like a canvas.

title: Lights, Camera, Reload
summary: The guns finally move: firing, reloading, pumping and drawing, with built-in sound markers.

title: Snap It On
summary: Scopes, silencers, grips, grenade launchers, lights and lasers, as separate pieces that snap onto any gun. Plus a whole kit for every world.

title: The Big Expansion
summary: Revolvers and rocket launchers join the factory, plus harpoons, tasers, a nail gun, a megacannon and dozens of new bodies, built by four robot helpers at once.

title: Make It Yours
summary: Real shapes for scopes and attachments, bayonets, swappable magazines, and suggested gameplay stats for every piece.
